B2 proposal applied at t -> FEMR frozen
B3 frozen GMT + Clean continuation -> K8 executed evidence

modules.title: 05 Paired Evidence 与 Gain
modules.summary: 确认每个 Segment 的 Clean/Noisy baseline 只执行一次，M 个 Repair 共用它们，并由唯一 v007 owner 产生 Recovery-Aware G_total
